ambiguity_resolution: human adjudication recorded by opaque reference
collection_gate: Replace unknown bindings with actual corpus, dataset revision, split, platforms, scaffold, prompts, context, tools and positive limits/repeats; freeze content-addressed manifest and protocol before collection. Any protocol/dataset/grading change requires a new benchmark version after first collection.
completion_rule: All declared cases and repeats must complete and be adjudicated; omit full-set aggregates for incomplete/cancelled sets. Never replace missing metrics with zero.
cost_denominator: per independently evaluated case; whole-run totals must be divided explicitly by this denominator
effort_capture: launched-verbatim-v1; omission or unknown remains unknown; never infer defaults

finding_match_criteria.criteria: Finding identifies the ground-truth defect and affected behavior using case-specific criteria.
finding_match_criteria.duplicate_handling: one TP per defect; duplicates receive no extra TP; adjudicate unsupported separate claims as FP

judge_instructions: Match each finding to one independently adjudicated defect. Duplicate findings receive no repeated TP credit. Unmatched findings are FP after human adjudication. Unmatched ground truth is FN. Resolve every ambiguity before completing the set.

metric_definitions.name: review_f1
metric_definitions.zero_denominator: omit; report correct clean reviews separately

sample_count_definition: independently evaluated cases; never findings, repeats, or F1 denominator
